a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def absolute_value(num):
    return -num if num < 0 else num

min_difference = 1e100
best_x = 0
best_y = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    x = i
    y_upper = int((a / b) * i)
    y_lower = y_upper + 1
    diff_upper = absolute_value((a / b) - (y_upper / x))
    diff_lower = absolute_value((a / b) - (y_lower / x))
    if min_difference > diff_upper:
        min_difference = diff_upper
        best_x = y_upper
        best_y = x
    if min_difference > diff_lower:
        min_difference = diff_lower
        best_x = y_lower
        best_y = x

print(f"{best_x}/{best_y}")
